freeze.cohort: Instance0 of each of 40 eligible TRAIN layouts; all 50 DEV invoices; all three Synthesized DEV variants. Other 360 TRAIN invoices excluded by budget before inference. No TEST/reserved members, new downloads or fitted weights.
freeze.selection: Exactly one explicit recipient-label anchor. Labels and stops fixed in code. Same-line suffix then at most six lines with normalized gaps [-0.25,2] median line heights, overlap >=0.25 of narrower line or left alignment within two heights. Nearest vertical continuation; competing branches within 0.5 heights conflict. Multiple labels conflict. No label, empty adjacency, invalid geometry or cap -> null. Never expected customer, annotated regions/text, issuer dictionaries or postal rules.
freeze.grounding: Synthesized uses original word-array indices. FATURA cached OCR has only lines: canonical whitespace tokens retain source line index, token offset, character span and entire original line box. No invented word-level geometry. Report this limitation.
freeze.ocr: Use fixed validated PP-OCR detail cache on DEV, same pinned reader/models on 40 TRAIN pages, two workers, one RTen/Rayon thread, 30s/page timeout. Failures retained as null.
freeze.metrics: FATURA eligible iff BILL_TO or BUYER annotation exists. Union of those regions; source token centres determine target membership. Exact source-index set requires nonempty target and selected output. Report selection/target/intersection counts, seller-region contamination, null/conflict counts, and unchanged public_documents token_score against recipient region text in y/x order. Ineligible pages retained separately, not negatives. Synthesized has no region truth: text score only against holder + street + city + state + full zip concatenation, no spatial score. No POA acceptance, US validation, field correctness or integration improvement claim.
freeze.no_tuning: One policy, one run, TRAIN and DEV separately reported; all failures retained.
